verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own SOC 2 control mapping into Unified Controls, a policy creation and approval workflow, and in-platform evidence requests tied to audits running from scoping through final report. That covers the core of running a SOC 2 program in the platform. However, the evidence never mentions Type I versus Type II audits or names the Trust Services Criteria, and it does not show SOC 2-specific required policy templates. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II support, explicit Trust Services Criteria coverage, SOC 2 required-policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: If you're used to working with a specific SOC 2 framework control, you can use this guide to identify its corresponding Unified Control.
Accelerate the ability to create, review, and acknowledge published policies with direct automation.
